div.head: II Atr 8
div.ab: Gyf hwa befo þæt him losod wæs, cenne se, ðe he hit æt befo, hwanon hit him come; sylle on hand ⁊ sette borh, þæt he bringe his geteaman in, ðær hit besprecen bið.
Si quis deprehendat quod amisit, aduocet inde cum quo deprehenditur, unde uenerit ei; et mittat in manum et det plegium, quod adducet aduocatum suum.

[Be ðon ðe mon gefô ðe him losod wæs.] Gyf hwa befo þæt him losod wæs, cenne se ðe he hit æt befo, hwanon hit him come; sylle on hand ⁊ sette borh, þæt he bringe his geteaman in ðær hit besprecen bið.

App. zu II Atr. 8. (Davon, dass jemand im Anefang fasst, was ihm verloren ging. Ld) Wenn jemand was ihm verloren ging, im Anefang fasst, so erkläre der [Besitzer], bei dem er es fasst, woher es an ihn [den Besitzer] gekommen sei, gelobe (in die Hand) und setze Bürgschaft, dass er seinen Gewährsmann dort, wo es eingeklagt worden ist, hinbringen werde.

Appendix to II Atr. 8. (Of attaching what one has lost. Ld) If anyone attaches what he had lost, let the [possessor] at whose house he attaches it declare where it came to him from, give a pledge (into the hand) and provide surety that he will bring his warrantor to the place where it is claimed.

[II Æthelred, Appendix.] If anyone attaches what he has lost, the man in whose possession it is attached shall declare how it came to him. He shall give pledges and furnish surety that he will produce his warrantor, when the case shall be brought into court.

Das Stück trennen in 2 Kapitel Ld und Q, also wahrscheinlich schon lq, auch wenn der Wortlaut beider Rubriken, trotz wörtlichen Anklanges, von l und Q ii unabhängig eingesetzt sein sollte
Ld and Q divide the piece into 2 chapters, and so probably lq did already, even if the wording of the two rubrics, despite verbal resemblance, should have been inserted independently by l and Q ii
Auf solche Frage im Anefang (s. d. Gl 4. 10) antwortet Beklagter II Cn 23; sie ergeht ebenso an die zur Gewähr gezogenen Vormänner; 8, 2³
To such a question in attachment (see that word in Gl 4. 10) the accused replies II Cn 23; it is likewise put to the previous possessors vouched to warranty; 8, 2³
Die ganze Redensart heisst ‘versprechen (s. d. Gl 2a), zunächst mit [später auch ohne] Handschlag’, nicht etwa ‘gebe es zur Hand [zurück (Price-Thorpe)]’ Schmid
The whole phrase means ‘promise (see that word in Gl 2a), originally with [later also without] a handshake’, not, say, ‘give it into the hand [back (Price-Thorpe)]’ Schmid

Wie vom ursprünglichen Beklagten, so vom Bezogenen empfängt Kläger dasselbe Versprechen; s. u. 9, 1²; Gl Bürgschaft 13c; Prozessualpfand 6. 9. Die Stellung des Gewährsmannes erfolgt zum Anefangsort laut u. 9

The claimant receives the same promise from the person vouched as from the original accused; see below 9, 1²; Gl Bürgschaft 13c; Prozessualpfand 6. 9. The warrantor is produced at the place of attachment, as below 9
